scope: Counting accuracy for bundled skewer endpoints at restaurant/barbecue checkout
accuracyFindings: Duplicate/false markers and missed terminal faces were confirmed in a manually annotated region of a real photo.
Changing confidence, overlap filtering, aspect scaling or tiling has not established a reliable improvement on the available evidence.

A local build 2 candidate tightens NMS IoU from 0.7 to 0.45 at confidence0.25, preserving scaleFill and original weights. On two small same-image regions TP9/FN2 stay unchanged while FP13 drops to11; overall counting acceptance remains blocked.

Frozen v2 adds 4 new holdout scenes / 213 visible endpoints. Build2 TP210 FP22 FN3; exact count0/2 and MAE1.5 for the two complete photos. Three product scenes and one POS demonstration do not establish field accuracy. No detector/model parameters changed.

Build3 adds automatic reference regions and conservative text/outlier filtering with unchanged model/NMS. Development TP674/FN38 unchanged, FP83 to34; new frozen v3 TP109/FN31 unchanged across140 confirmed endpoints. The sole nominal FP reduction is uncertainty-boundary-sensitive, not reliable evidence of general background filtering. Detection-derived reference boxes can exclude original missed ends.
requiredNextEvidence: Improve base-model recall using representative round endpoint training data, then validate on new frozen source groups and physical iPhone photos. Automatic region filtering cannot recover missed endpoints.
initialDataRequest: Superseded: user directed assistant to collect and annotate online photos. First frozen set completed:5sourcegroups/499visibleendpoints.
releaseScope: Assisted counting with required whole-photo manual review and correction; not unattended automatic checkout
